models.name: Clay hypoplasticity 2013 — Appendix law, zero spin (draft)
models.description: Draft laboratory candidate of Mašín2013 author-manuscript Appendix Eqs43–58 at zero spin, with effective compression-positive Cauchy stress and void ratio. Fixed spatial infinitesimal3D restriction; no finite objective transport, IGS or 2014 anisotropy. Illustrative parameters are software fixtures, distinct from Table1 fictitious eval. and material calibrations; require explicit stress/e, with no inferred specimen preparation. Exact isotropic continuation and conservative unresolved-arithmetic rejection are project choices. Existing invariant guards do not certify eigenvalue signs arbitrarily close to singular stress; no clipping or stress floor. ASBS is diagnostic rather than a yield barrier; an evaluable initial state need not have a verified physical preparation. No universal-SPD accuracy, experimental validation, human scientific admission or validated zero/near-isotropic update tangent. See linked source, preparation and precision limitations.
